PLAN 07 | SHOTS 18-19 | THE HALL
Create a 15-second Seedance 2.5 cinematic sequence, horizontal 16:9. Exactly 2 shots with the local timing below. Preserve the assigned identities, masks, wardrobe, animal design and location geometry. Performance is expressed through posture, hands, breathing and weight. Render at natural speed with tactile analog texture.
CHARACTER REFERENCES
CHAR_SHAHRNAZ = {{CHAR_SHAHRNAZ}}
CHAR_ARNAVAZ = {{CHAR_ARNAVAZ}}
CHAR_ZAHHAK = {{CHAR_ZAHHAK}}
CHAR_GUARD_A = {{CHAR_GUARD_A}}
CHAR_GUARD_B = {{CHAR_GUARD_B}}
CHAR_GUARD_C = {{CHAR_GUARD_C}}
ANIMAL REFERENCES
ANIMAL_CAT = {{ANIMAL_CAT}}
LOCATION REFERENCES
LOC_ZAHHAK_HALL = {{LOC_ZAHHAK_HALL}}
PROP REFERENCES
PROP_STAFF = {{PROP_STAFF}}
PROP_BLADE = {{PROP_BLADE}}
START STATE AND BLOCKING
STATE_CONFRONTATION_ENTRY. Six adults and one cat. Shahrnaz carries the cat; Arnavaz is dusty, unsteady and lowered at the left shoulder. Zahhak waits at the far end, staff in right hand, established serpents quiet. The blade rests on the existing low ledge along the left side of the women’s route.

SHOT 18 | 00:00-00:08 | ACROSS THE THRESHOLD
24mm from just inside the hall, facing the entrance at an oblique angle. Retreat alongside the arriving sisters, then turn attention with their gaze toward Zahhak. Handheld shake gradually settles. The foreground blade is briefly readable on the left ledge as the group passes it.
SHOT 19 | 00:08-00:15 | THE DISTANCE TO HIM
Cut to 35mm from behind the sisters, entrance-side of the confrontation axis. Their shoulders frame Zahhak four meters away. A and B stop them on the specified marks; C remains to their right. Zahhak completes one short uneven step using his right-hand staff, then becomes still. Hold the entire distance between them.
LIGHT AND IMAGE
Dark hall with a fixed high light behind and slightly left of the sisters, casting their elongated shadows toward Zahhak across visible stone. Weak practical fill makes bodies readable. Keep this light geometry for blocks 08–12.
SOUND
Footsteps expand into a longer hall reverberation, then stop. Staff weight on stone, fabric settling, strained breath and distant room tone.
END STATE AND EDIT
Facing Zahhak: Shahrnaz stands left and Arnavaz right, one meter apart and four meters from him. A stands behind Shahrnaz; B behind Arnavaz; C farther right. The blade stays on the left ledge within two steps of Shahrnaz.
Keep all character designs and prop ownership consistent across cuts. Use the camera paths stated for each shot and retain readable spatial relationships. Primitive ritual fashion cinema, analog realism. NO MUSIC, NO DIALOGUE.

- PLAN 07 | SHOTS 18A–18C | THE FIRST ENCOUNTER

Create a 15-second cinematic sequence for Seedance 2.5.
Horizontal 16:9.
Exactly three shots.

The guards deliver Shahrnaz and Arnavaz into Zahhak’s chamber, release them and leave. Zahhak has been waiting alone.

The emotional transition is from forced physical movement to the stillness of a first encounter with a terrifying presence.

CHARACTER REFERENCES:
Shahrnaz = {{CHAR_SHAHRNAZ}}
Arnavaz = {{CHAR_ARNAVAZ}}
Zahhak, including his established shoulder serpents = {{CHAR_ZAHHAK}}
Guard A = {{CHAR_GUARD_A}}
Guard B = {{CHAR_GUARD_B}}
Guard C = {{CHAR_GUARD_C}}

ANIMAL REFERENCE:
Cat = {{ANIMAL_CAT}}

LOCATION REFERENCE:
Zahhak’s chamber = {{LOC_ZAHHAK_HALL}}

VISIBLE PROP REFERENCE:
Zahhak’s staff = {{PROP_STAFF}}

Preserve the exact referenced masks, costumes, proportions, serpents and cat.

Use the chamber’s architectural shell and open, continuous floor. Keep the space between Zahhak and the sisters clear, all standing at the same floor level. The visible set consists of the surrounding architecture and Zahhak’s staff.

START STATE:

Zahhak waits alone inside the chamber, standing four meters beyond the entrance, his weight supported by the staff in his right hand.

A escorts Shahrnaz by her left upper arm. She securely supports the frightened cat against her chest.

B and C support Arnavaz by her upper arms. Her left shoulder remains lowered after the corridor assault. Stone dust marks her left sleeve and lower garment; her steps are unsteady.

This is the sisters’ first encounter with Zahhak.

SHOT 18A | 00:00–00:06 | DELIVERED AND ABANDONED

28mm restrained handheld medium-wide shot from just inside the chamber, looking obliquely toward the entrance.

The guards bring the sisters across the threshold and stop them just inside: Shahrnaz left, Arnavaz right.

The camera retreats one short step to accommodate their arrival. Residual handheld instability settles as their movement stops.

A releases Shahrnaz. B and C release Arnavaz carefully enough for her to find her footing. Her knees soften; she steadies herself beside her sister.

The three guards immediately turn and leave through the same doorway behind them. Keep their departure visible until the last guard clears the threshold.

The sisters remain facing deeper into the chamber. The cat stays in Shahrnaz’s arms.

End with the guards fully outside and the sisters left alone with Zahhak.

SHOT 18B | 00:06–00:10 | HE HAS BEEN WAITING

50mm medium composition of Zahhak from the sisters’ side of the room, just below his eye level.

Zahhak stands alone, facing them, his right hand weighted on the staff. His left hand rests beside his body.

Make a slow, physically restrained push-in of approximately forty centimeters.

His stillness suggests that their arrival was expected. As they settle before him, he inclines his masked head by only a few degrees.

The established serpents remain integrated into his silhouette. One makes a small adjustment beside his shoulder, enough for the sisters to register its living presence.

A narrow existing highlight defines part of his mask, the staff and a section of scales.

Hold his attention directed toward the sisters.

SHOT 18C | 00:10–00:15 | THE SISTERS SEE HIM

50mm intimate two-shot from Zahhak’s side, holding both sisters together at chest height.

Shahrnaz remains left, Arnavaz right. Their eyelines converge on Zahhak just beside the lens.

Begin wide enough to include the cat and both women’s hands. Move slowly thirty centimeters closer, keeping both masks and their contrasting postures readable.

Shahrnaz’s breathing catches. Her forearms draw the cat slightly closer while maintaining its support. Her masked head lifts a few centimeters, then stops.

Arnavaz initially holds her head higher. As she takes in Zahhak and the movement beside his shoulder, her remaining defiance becomes rigid stillness. Her right hand begins moving toward Shahrnaz’s sleeve and stops just short of touching it.

Her injured left shoulder stays low. She makes one small adjustment of her feet to remain standing.

The cat presses against Shahrnaz, ears lowered.

Hold their first sustained look at Zahhak. End with both sisters still standing before him.

CAMERA AND PERFORMANCE:

Let the arrival retain a trace of the corridor’s unsettled handheld movement. After the guards leave, camera movement becomes slow, close and deliberate.

The two push-ins create a reciprocal first encounter: Zahhak observing the women, then the women absorbing his presence.

Fear appears through interrupted breathing, arrested gestures, protective hands and changes in posture beneath the fixed masks.

Maintain the shared eyeline axis and consistent positions throughout.

LIGHT AND SOUND:

Use the chamber’s established available light. A directional source behind and slightly left of the sisters casts their shadows deeper into the room. Restrained reflected light reveals Zahhak’s mask and shoulder serpents.

Sound begins with boots, dragging soles and clothing under tension. The departing guards’ footsteps recede into the corridor.

After their departure, retain sparse chamber resonance, the sisters’ breathing, quiet contact between fur and fabric, and a faint movement of scales against Zahhak’s costume.

END STATE:

Exactly three adults and one cat remain inside:
Zahhak, Shahrnaz, Arnavaz and the cat.

The guards are outside.

Zahhak stands four meters from the sisters, staff in his right hand.
Shahrnaz holds the cat.
Arnavaz stands beside her, unsteady, with her left shoulder lowered.

The encounter remains suspended in quiet mutual observation.

NO MUSIC, NO DIALOGUE.
